critical_findings: The only V2-eligible case, S7Q-005, had zero graph-exclusive relevant items.
Its four novel selected snippets had zero marginal graph coverage and were selected only by the novelty bonus.
S7Q-009 had genuine graph-exclusive evidence but was blocked by an inconsistent model-supplied graph_sufficient flag.
Factoid and yes/no direct-relation questions should not be the primary GraphRAG routing scope.
The next gate must test list and summary questions and must require counterfactual graph-exclusive coverage.
summary.decision: Run a final routing-scope V3 gate on three list and three summary questions. Remove zero-coverage novelty, treat graph_sufficient as advisory, and require useful graph-exclusive evidence. If fewer than two of six qualify, remove GraphRAG as a central architectural claim.
